abstract: Forty-four women underwent laparoscopic surgery for treatment of 49 benign dermoid cysts in 1992 and 1993. Four patients presented with bilateral ovarian masses and one patient had two teratomas within one ovary. In the majority of cases (78.9%) the correct diagnosis was made preoperatively by pelvic examination and vaginal ultrasound. The average tumor size was 5.5 cm, ranging from 1 to 11 cm. Preservation of the ovary was achieved in most cases (40/81.6%). Uni- or bilateral adnexectomy was the treatment of choice in all postmenopausal women (5); in the remaining four patients salpingo-oophorectomy was performed due to torsion of a cyst (1), extensive adhesions (1) and large tumor size (2). CA 19-9 levels were elevated in 11 out of 20 patients, reaching a maximum value of 3,400 U/ml. No severe complications were encountered: two patients developed fever postoperatively, one of whom was suspected of having a chemical granulomatous peritonitis. We conclude that laparoscopic management of benign dermoid cysts is safe and effective and can therefore be highly recommended.
abstract_ja: 1992年と1993年に、44人の女性が49個の良性類皮嚢腫に対し腹腔鏡手術を受けた。両側卵巣腫瘤が4例、1つの卵巣に2個の奇形腫があった例が1例であった。大多数の症例(78.9%)では、内診と経膣超音波検査により術前に正しい診断が得られた。腫瘍の平均径は5.5cm(1〜11cm)であった。卵巣の温存は大多数(40例、81.6%)で達成された。閉経後女性(5例)では全例で片側または両側の付属器摘出術が治療の第一選択であった。残る4例では、嚢腫の捻転(1例)、高度の癒着(1例)、腫瘍の大きさ(2例)のために卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。CA 19-9は20例中11例で上昇し、最大値は3,400U/mlに達した。重篤な合併症は認められなかった。術後発熱が2例に生じ、そのうち1例は化学的肉芽腫性腹膜炎が疑われた。良性類皮嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡治療は安全かつ有効であり、強く推奨できると結論する。
